# Brand artwork notices

The logo assets in this directory are third-party brand artwork. The SuperIntelligence MIT license does not relicense these marks or grant trademark rights. Their inclusion does not imply endorsement or affiliation.

## Hugging Face

Copyright and trademark rights remain with Hugging Face, Inc. Both original SVGs were downloaded from the official [brand assets](https://huggingface.co/brand) dataset. That dataset does not state an open-source asset license. Consult the [official brand page](https://huggingface.co/brand) and [terms](https://huggingface.co/terms-of-service) for usage information.

The color and monochrome path geometry is preserved. The monochrome artwork is uniformly scaled to share the color artwork’s coordinate system; the common isometric carrier is separate SuperIntelligence artwork.

## NVIDIA

NVIDIA and the NVIDIA logo are trademarks and/or registered trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation. All rights reserved. The source SVG is the official inline logo from [nvidia.com](https://www.nvidia.com/); the compact icon extracts its native green eyemark.

NVIDIA’s [logo and brand guidelines](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/legal-info/logo-brand-usage/) reserve usage authorization and specify requirements for official logo reproduction. This package grants no NVIDIA trademark permission. The isometric carrier and monochrome variants are this project’s presentation, not official NVIDIA assets.

See `sources.json` for exact source URLs, transformations, and SHA-256 hashes.
